title: The Forgotten Monument
logline: A veteran wants to restore a forgotten monument to their old squad, but the local archivist wants it destroyed to build a new data center.

roles.description: Stubborn, nostalgic, refusing to let the past die.
Pragmatic, forward-looking, views history as a waste of space.
A crumbling memorial on a neglected asteroid.

public_situation: A prime piece of asteroid real estate is slated for demolition to make way for a corporate data center.
private_truth: The site contains the only remaining physical record of a suppressed historical battle.

beats.public_change: The archivist files the final demolition permits.

missions.reason: Needs high-grade structural resin delivered to stabilize the monument before demolition crews arrive.
missions.private_fact: The veteran plans to chain themselves to the monument to stop the demolition.

beats.public_change: The demolition is delayed due to an anonymous historical injunction.

missions.reason: Needs a pilot to scan the monument to certify its structural instability.
missions.private_fact: The archivist intends to use a 'dangerous' certification to bypass the injunction.

beats.public_change: The veteran reveals the suppressed history of the monument.

missions.reason: Needs the original physical casualty list transported to the site for a final dedication ceremony.
missions.private_fact: The casualty list proves the local government abandoned the squad.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the casualty list and must decide its fate.

options.label: Deliver the list to the veteran
Give the list to the archivist to destroy
Negotiate a compromise to move the monument

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the casualty list.
resolutions.summary: The monument is protected by historical society mandate. The veteran finds peace, and the data center is canceled.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot abandons the missions or certifies the site unsafe.
resolutions.summary: The monument is pulverized. The data center is built over the erased history of the squad.
The monument is moved to a private museum. The data center is built, and the veteran accepts a hollow victory.

loose_threads.detail: The data center project is entirely funded by a mysterious off-world holding company.
The original retreat orders for the battle were issued by a shipping conglomerate, not a general.

radio_hooks: Protests delay construction at asteroid site.
Local historical society debates value of crumbling ruins.

voice_direction.old_veteran: Quiet, intense, never breaking eye contact when speaking.
voice_direction.local_archivist: Brisk, impatient, constantly checking the time.
